notes.title: Exciting news for all our fans and virtual reality enthusiasts!
notes.notes:
[h2]Exciting news for all our fans and virtual reality enthusiasts![/h2]
We are thrilled to announce that our very own VR experience, [i]Battlescar[/i], has been featured in Forbes' Top 10 VR Experiences to Watch! 🥳

This incredible recognition is a testament to the hard work and dedication of our talented team, who are committed to delivering immersive and captivating experiences for our users.

Forbes praised [i]Battlescar [/i]for its [b]engaging storyline, cutting-edge graphics, and innovative use of VR technology[/b]. We're honored to be included among the best VR experiences available and grateful for the continued support of our fans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38304669/c7d012223cf3618bdbb052be14199ff672130811.png[/img]

If you haven't yet dived into the thrilling world of [i]Battlescar[/i], now is the perfect time to join the adventure! 🧑‍🎤
Explore a gritty, punk-rock universe where you'll follow the lives of two rebellious young girls as they navigate the challenges of their chaotic world. Experience the intense visuals and gripping narrative that captured the attention of Forbes and countless fans worldwide.

[b]Don't miss your chance to experience the action firsthand and see why Forbes has included us in their Top 10 VR Experiences to Watch.[/b]

Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to bringing you even more extraordinary VR experiences in the future!

notes.title: Coming Soon: VR fiction Battlescar will be available in January on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38304669/987bba204341aa6c5df09c09e1b9a156311c47a1.png[/img]
1978, New York City. Lupe, a young Puerto Rican American teenager, meets Debbie in a juvenile detention centre. Fascinating and self-destructive, Debbie exposes Lupe to the underground scene of the 1970’s Lower East side.
Despite their total lack of musical abilities, the two runaways decide to form their own punk music band, pushed by the powerful lyrics written by Lupe.

Both coming of age story and ode to coming of age, Battlescar explores the theme of identity. With its two strong female leads, the movie borrows from New York punk’s traditions and reveals to the viewer the secrets worlds co-existing in the Lower East Side in the late 70’s through the use of animation and immersive environments in virtual reality.
